aggregation: Latency pools all recorded API responses; decisions and safety events are equal-weight episode means, including valid failed-goal episodes.
safetyDefinition: Safety events include active and passive collision contacts, trip/oil/water interactions, red-light violations and illegal crossings. Repeated contacts may count more than once.
limitations: Exploratory single-seed routes, selected by geometry rather than outcomes. Short-route selection, provider-specific reasoning settings, differing serving providers and collection times limit generalization. Incomplete runs, output-truncated episodes and identity-mismatched responses are excluded from this validated snapshot; exclusion can bias estimates. Supplemental reruns are not pooled.

missing.deepseek_old: Tasks 0 and 20 are excluded from validated aggregates: output truncation in a completed vehicle-collision episode, and a wall-time timeout. The failed episode remains recorded.
missing.gpt_astra: Tasks 1 and 18 were interrupted by returned-model identity mismatches.
